item.title: Morgan County Courthouse temporarily closing for electrical renovations, courthouse offices relocated
item.description: The Morgan County Courthouse will temporarily close on February 16 for electrical renovations, with the closure expected to last two to four weeks. Offices in the courthouse will begin relocating on February 9, according to the Morgan County Sheriff's Office.Below is information on where the offices will operate during the closure:-Morgan County Sheriff's Office, 119 Lee Street NE, Decatur, AL 35601▪️Veterans Affairs Office▪️Community Corrections▪️State Probation▪️Morgan County Circuit/District

item.title: Calhoun County rehab escape underscores need for regulations, Oxford PD says
item.description: Officials in Calhoun County are raising concerns associated with rehabilitation facilities and halfway houses after the escape of a suspect with an extensive criminal history.Daniel Lee Jackson reportedly escaped from an Oxford rehabilitation center on Monday. Jackson, who has a history of burglary and breaking and entering vehicles charges in Mobile County, has since turned himself in. item.title: Senate advances bill requiring DHR to request waiver from USDA to exclude candy, soda from SNAP
item.description: MONTGOMERY — Members of the Senate General Fund Budget committee passed legislation requiring a State agency to apply for a waiver from the federal government to exclude some junk food from the SNAP program.The bill by State Sen. Arthur Orr (R-Decatur) would require the Department of Human Resources to request a waiver from the United States Department of Agriculture Food and Nutrition Service to exclude candy and soda from the definition of eligible food for purposes of SNAP benefits. item.title: State Rep. Simpson’s wife offers medical update
item.description: State Rep. Matt Simpson (R-Daphne) is "recovering well" after being hospitalized for a medical emergency on Tuesday, according to his wife. item.title: Homeland Security Investigations, Florence Police Department arrest man on two counts of sexual abuse
item.description: Florence Police Department detectives partnered with Homeland Security Investigations on Tuesday to arrest a man suspected of sexual abuse.According to FPD, law enforcement executed a search warrant at a local restaurant where Eleazar Hernandez-Trujillo was located. After making contact, police detectives interviewed Hernandez-Trujillo and placed him under arrest for two counts of Sexual Abuse First Degree. item.title: Chattanooga man indicted in DeKalb County corrections officer assault
item.description: The United States District Court announced the indictment of a Chattanooga, Tenn. man for the assault of a DeKalb County corrections officer.Thomas Elliott, 31, is charged with forcibly assaulting a corrections officer. A Huntsville grand jury handed down the indictment after hearing evidence.The incident occurred in November 2025. item.title: 4 takeaways from Alabama's 100-97 win over Texas A&M
item.description: Alabama bounced back after an embarrassing loss with a 100-97 win over Texas A&M on Wednesday.Two of the fastest-paced teams in the country battled it out from start to finish, producing one of the most entertaining games of the season. The Crimson Tide were able to put the embarrassing loss to Florida behind them and bounce back as the SEC schedule begins to get tougher.
